$comment: Per agency type, the copy a filled site uses where the company has given none: true for any agency of the type, never a claim about a client. The platform fills company_name, city, contact_email and year from the company, and replaces intro, audience and pricing_note with the owner's setup answers when it has them. No proof and no logos: those only ever come from the company.

recruiting.tagline: Hires found from a written brief, agreed before we search
recruiting.intro: We find people for the roles you need to fill. Every search starts with a written brief, agreed with you before we approach a single candidate.
recruiting.audience: Companies hiring for roles where a good shortlist matters more than a long one, from first hires to senior leaders.
recruiting.pricing_note: Fees are agreed in writing before a search starts, and you know what you pay and when before we approach anyone.

services.title: Contingent search
services.description: For single roles you are also hiring for directly. We send a short list of people we have spoken to, and you pay only if one of them joins.

services.title: Retained search
services.description: For senior and hard to fill roles. A dedicated search with a mapped market, a written update every week and a shortlist you can compare.

services.title: Team builds
services.description: When you need several people at once. One brief, one point of contact, and interviews planned around your team's week.

services.title: Role brief writing
services.description: We turn a loose headcount into a written role brief: scope, level, salary band and interview loop. Yours to keep, whoever you hire through.

process.title: Write the brief
process.description: We write the role up with the hiring manager: the work, the team, the band and the must haves. You sign it off before anyone is approached.

process.title: Search and screen
process.description: We approach people who match the brief, speak to each one ourselves and send a short list with a note on why each person fits.

process.title: Interview and close
process.description: We schedule interviews, gather feedback from both sides after each round and handle the offer until your new hire has signed.

security-testing.tagline: Your product tested the way your customers use it
security-testing.intro: We test the journeys people take through your web and mobile products, such as sign up, checkout and settings, and send a plain report your developers can act on.
security-testing.audience: Product teams shipping web and mobile software, from a first release to a weekly release train.
security-testing.pricing_note: A fee per product, sized by how many journeys we cover and how often you release, agreed before the first run.

services.title: Release checks
services.description: Before each release we run your agreed journeys end to end and report what passed, what broke and the exact steps to see it break.

services.title: New feature testing
services.description: We test a new flow while it is still in staging, including the odd paths: back buttons, expired sessions and half filled forms.

services.title: Device and browser coverage
services.description: Your key journeys on the phones, tablets and browsers your customers use, so what works on a laptop also works on an older phone.

services.title: Accessibility journey checks
services.description: We complete your main journeys with a keyboard and a screen reader and report where someone relying on them gets stuck.

process.title: Map the journeys
process.description: We agree with you which journeys matter most and write each one down as steps, so every run checks the same thing.

process.title: Run the tests
process.description: We work through every journey on the devices and browsers you choose and record each issue with the steps to reproduce it.

process.title: Report and recheck
process.description: You get a plain report before you ship. Once a fix lands, we run the journey again and tell you it passes.

market-research.tagline: Research that answers the question you need to decide on
market-research.intro: We run market and customer research for teams with a decision to make. Every study starts from the question you need answered and ends with a plain written answer.
market-research.audience: Founders, product and marketing teams who need evidence before they enter a market, launch a product or change a price.
market-research.pricing_note: A fixed fee per study, set by its scope and agreed in writing before fieldwork starts.

services.title: Market sizing
services.description: How big the market you are looking at is, who is in it and how it is changing, built up from sources we name.

services.title: Customer interviews
services.description: We talk to the people you want to sell to and report what they said, what they meant and what it means for your decision.

services.title: Competitor reviews
services.description: Who you are up against, what they offer and charge, and where they leave room for you.

services.title: Surveys
services.description: A survey designed around your question, sent to the right people, with the results read for you rather than handed over raw.

process.title: Frame the question
process.description: We agree the decision the research supports and the question it has to answer, so the study stays on point.

process.title: Gather the evidence
process.description: We run the interviews, surveys and desk research the question needs, and keep every source so you can check it.

process.title: Write the answer
process.description: You get a short written answer to your question, the evidence behind it and what we would do next in your place.

paid-ads.tagline: Paid ads that are tested, measured and plainly reported
paid-ads.intro: We plan, make and run paid ads for businesses that want every dollar of spend accounted for, with a plain report on what worked.
paid-ads.audience: Businesses ready to spend on paid search and social, from a first campaign to accounts that need a fresh pair of hands.
paid-ads.pricing_note: A monthly management fee agreed before we start, kept separate from your ad spend, which you pay to the platforms directly.

services.title: Campaign setup
services.description: Accounts, tracking and campaigns built properly from the start, so every result can be traced back to the ad that earned it.

services.title: Ad creative
services.description: Copy and simple visuals written for each platform and audience, with several versions so the best one can win.

services.title: Ongoing management
services.description: Budgets, bids and audiences adjusted every week from what the numbers say, not from habit.

services.title: Reporting
services.description: A plain report on what you spent, what it brought in and what we are changing next, in words as well as charts.

process.title: Audit and plan
process.description: We look at what you have run before, agree the goal and the budget, and write a plan for the first month.

process.title: Build and launch
process.description: We set up tracking, write the ads and launch them, with each campaign named so its results are easy to read.

process.title: Test and report
process.description: We test new ads against the best ones, move budget to what works and report what changed and why.

seo-geo.tagline: Found in search and in the answers people ask for
seo-geo.intro: We help businesses get found when people search and when they ask AI assistants for a recommendation, with technical fixes, useful content and plain reporting.
seo-geo.audience: Businesses that want more of their customers to find them through search and AI answers, from local services to online stores.
seo-geo.pricing_note: A monthly fee agreed before we start, sized by the size of your site and how much new content you need.

services.title: Technical audit
services.description: We check how search engines and AI crawlers read your site and fix what stops your pages being found, indexed or quoted.

services.title: Content
services.description: Pages and articles written to answer the questions your customers actually ask, in your voice and checked for accuracy.

services.title: AI answer visibility
services.description: We track whether AI assistants mention you when people ask about your field, and work on the pages that make them do so.

services.title: Reporting
services.description: A plain monthly report on rankings, mentions and visits, and what we are doing next to improve them.

process.title: Audit
process.description: We review your site, your rankings and how AI assistants describe you, and list the fixes in order of impact.

process.title: Fix and write
process.description: We make the technical fixes and publish content that answers your customers' questions better than anyone else.

process.title: Track and report
process.description: We measure what moved each month and tell you plainly what worked, what did not and what comes next.

general.tagline: A small team that does the work and tells you how it went
general.intro: We are an agency that takes on client work with a clear scope, a named point of contact and plain updates from the first week.
general.audience: Businesses that want work done well by a team that answers quickly and writes things down.
general.pricing_note: Every engagement is scoped and priced in writing before work starts, so you know what you pay and what you get.

services.title: Project work
services.description: A piece of work with a clear scope, a fixed price and a date, delivered by the people you met at the start.

services.title: Ongoing support
services.description: A monthly arrangement for work that never quite stops, with a plan agreed each month and a report at the end of it.

services.title: Strategy sessions
services.description: A focused session to work through a problem with you and leave you with a written plan, whoever carries it out.

services.title: Reviews
services.description: A fresh look at work already done, with a plain list of what to keep, what to fix and what to stop.

process.title: Agree the scope
process.description: We talk through what you need, then write down the scope, the price and the dates for you to approve.

process.title: Do the work
process.description: We get on with it and send a short update every week, so you always know where things stand.

process.title: Review together
process.description: We go through the result with you, fix what needs fixing and agree what, if anything, comes next.
